description: Manage supplier catalogues, customer prices and orders for businesses supplying other businesses, with your TradeCatalog permissions and reviewed changes.

interface.longDescription: Sign in or register securely, then set up a supplier catalogue after confirming your business details. For businesses supplying bakery, food, IT, office, beauty, cleaning, building and other products, from one-person suppliers to teams. Connect your TradeCatalog account to search products at your agreed prices, prepare orders and manage catalogues. Buyers use their own customer accounts. Staff manage products, customer terms, price changes, orders, news and support. Owner controls stay owner-only. Consequential changes show a confirmation card before they run; clients without cards use a signed-in review. Credential creation and file uploads finish securely in TradeCatalog.
defaultPrompt: Set up a supplier catalogue for my bakery business.
Find products at my agreed prices.
Prepare an order for me to review.
